# `irs527_related_entities`

**IRS Form 8871 related entities**

Connected organizations and related entities (record type R) disclosed on IRS Form 8871 notices in PolOrgsFullData.zip.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All related-entity records present in the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_related_entities.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
